items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: Sure, I know George. Good. I worked with George. I worked in George Band.

ctx.x: Are you any kin to George Williams? No, I'm not kin to George Williams. Did you ever know him?

The drummer George Williams? Yeah. Sure, I know George. Good. I worked with George. I worked in George Band. During the time him and Poirier worked together. And we worked at that same plate that he called the Blue Angel on Boyfriend Street in the 200 block. Long time ago. Long time ago. I worked with George. George and Poirier? George and Poirier. And who else? Do you remember? I don't remember. I can't recall.
And did George ever work in your band? No, George never worked in my band. Not regular. No.
